title: a join: whose as: selects the branch
notes: Was `array should be: text` at `join.as` -- a claim against the field the user had right, and one which, followed, silently turns the array into text. `const_tagged_branch` selects `JoinArray` from `as: array`, so the complaint lands on `with:`, the field that branch does not take. No near miss is offered because `with` is not close to `as`; Fix 0 and Why 1 record that the message does not yet say that `with:` belongs to `as: text` joins.
